method: Own IAB, read-only parsing of textContent of inline script DOM elements; no hidden window state, no eval, no network interception. Selected public property fields only; no credentials retained.

cian.location: inline script window._cianConfig['frontend-offer-card']; JSON array passed to concat; entry key=defaultState, value.offerData.offer
cian.limitation: Config base URL is not proof of an arbitrary-offer read endpoint. Examined main JS contains archive/delete APIs, not invoked. Official get-my-offers is a separate own-listings service.

domclick.location: inline script window.__SSR_STATE__; productCard and productCard.originalProduct
domclick.format: Serialized JavaScript object contains undefined and further assignments; not pure JSON document. Root object isolated structurally, standalone undefined temporarily mapped to null for read-only inspection. Source null vs undefined must not be conflated in future extraction.
domclick.api_derivation: getProductCard: GET /v6/offers/${deal}/${typePlural}/${id}; TYPE_FLAT -> flats; service OFFER_CARD_API -> https://offer-card.domclick.ru/api
